topic: Effects of Heat on Solids and Liquids
key_concepts: Heating some solids can change them into liquids.
Sugar, butter, ice, and candle wax melt when heated.
Melting is a solid-to-liquid change caused by heat.
Heating a liquid can change it into a gas.
Water becomes gas when it absorbs enough heat.
Boiling water is an example of liquid changing to gas.
Cooking can release water vapor from liquid.
Evaporation happens naturally in the environment.
Temperature changes cause materials to change state.
